name: id
description: Snapshot-row identifier: one row per customer per month-end snapshot (a long panel), rows not sorted by customer

name: customer_id
description: Customer the snapshot row belongs to; each customer appears once per month-end snapshot

name: seen_at
description: Month-end date of the snapshot the row was taken at: 2025-01-31, 2025-02-28 or 2025-03-31

name: plan
description: Subscription plan the customer held at that snapshot: basic, plus or pro
